title: a plan cannot be extended once implementation has started
desc: sdd audit is a pre-implementation gate, so re-auditing after an edit reports mismatch on the parts already done. But plan-change tells you to update the plan when it turns out wrong, which is exactly what happens mid-implementation. Today the only way through is to revert, extend the plan, re-audit and redo. Hit on WB-11. Options: audit citations against the merge-base rather than the working tree, or an explicit --since-implemented mode.
